description: This PHP class, BaseConfig, provides a configuration utility that allows merging arrays, checking for values, retrieving values with defaults, and setting values. It extends ArrayObject and is used for managing configuration settings within the project.

classes.name: BaseConfig
classes.description: A class for managing configuration data with merged arrays and key-value access methods.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges an array into the current configuration object, optionally overriding existing values, handling nested arrays.

methods.name: hasValue
methods.description: Checks if a given key exists in the configuration.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key, returning a default if the key does not exist.

methods.name: isTruthy
methods.description: Determines if the value associated with a key evaluates to true.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a key to a specified value in the configuration.
